tk-router.fallback: Thunderkit owns bootstrap and routing because model selection and lifecycle policy must remain local.

tk-test.fallback: Thunderkit owns preflight because configured model reachability requires its own evidence checks.

tk-ask.fallback: Thunderkit owns answer validation because its response constraints must remain consistent across peers.

targets.notes: Return bounded clarification questions without writes; Thunderkit owns the interview and user decisions.

tk-grill.fallback: Thunderkit conducts its own bounded intake when compatible native interview support is unavailable.

targets.notes: Return ambiguity findings and questions without writes; Thunderkit owns specification acceptance.

tk-spec.fallback: Thunderkit clarifies the specification itself when native interview findings cannot be safely obtained.

Read-only onboarding findings; Thunderkit assembles and persists the repository map.

tk-map.fallback: Thunderkit maps the repository with its own scoped reconnaissance when no qualified native component is ready.

targets.notes: Return decision questions and alternatives without writes; the user decides and Thunderkit records the choices.

tk-discuss.fallback: Thunderkit frames implementation choices itself when a qualified native interview component is unavailable.

targets.notes: Own the native research workflow within the agreed scope; return findings and evidence to Thunderkit.
Own the native research workflow using the categorized selector and return sourced evidence.

tk-research.fallback: Thunderkit performs its own scoped research when native workflow provenance or model bindings cannot be proven.

targets.notes: Return read-only findings for a bounded knowledge question; Thunderkit owns synthesis and persistence.
Return read-only research findings rather than taking ownership of the learning workflow.
Read-only skill discovery and recommendations only; never install or activate discovered skills.

tk-learn.fallback: Thunderkit answers knowledge questions or reports discovery limits itself when compatible native components are unavailable.

targets.notes: Own the native planning workflow; prove the requested planner binding before handoff.
Own the native planning workflow; this categorized target belongs to oh-my-hermes, not the same-named peer skill.

tk-plan.fallback: Thunderkit writes its own scoped plan when neither qualified native planner can honor the requested model binding.

targets.notes: Requires an enforceable no-delivery opt-out: no --make-pr/--ship, no push/PR/merge; otherwise refuse native execution.
Own native execution only inside the task-owned HERMES_HOME; keep executor bindings isolated and delivery unapproved.

tk-execute.fallback: Thunderkit coordinates its own scoped execution when native safety gates fail and approved model bindings remain provable.

targets.notes: Return read-only diff findings; Thunderkit retains plan review and the cross-family review gate.

tk-review.fallback: Thunderkit owns plan review and performs its own diff review when the native component cannot satisfy review policy.

targets.notes: Return bounded visual findings without repairs; Thunderkit owns captures, acceptance checks, and persistence.
prepares/assesses; wrapper collects captures

tk-verify-work.fallback: Thunderkit owns CLI and API checks and evaluates visual evidence itself when native assessment is unavailable.

targets.notes: Own the scoped native debugging workflow and return root-cause evidence plus verification results.
investigation plan only

tk-debug.fallback: Thunderkit runs its own evidence-driven debugging when native ownership is unavailable or only investigation advice can be returned.

targets.notes: Return read-only readiness findings; Thunderkit owns preparation and any separate delivery approval.

tk-ship.fallback: Thunderkit prepares delivery evidence itself because native findings never authorize publication or merging.

tk-docs.fallback: Thunderkit owns documentation writing and verification because no qualified native target is declared.

targets.notes: Return read-only evidence gaps and findings; Thunderkit owns the audit and final acceptance decision.

tk-audit.fallback: Thunderkit audits the evidence itself when native findings are unavailable or insufficient for its acceptance policy.

tk-memory.fallback: Thunderkit owns memory viewing and saving because project context must remain under its persistence policy.
